changed_payloads.science_correction: Issue1237 W01-PREP-B-002/CHEM-COMP-003: JCM1479 explicitly specifies the L-cysteine hydrochloride monohydrate 5% stock at pH7.0. It is a preparation, separate from solid solute. Unreported pH in another 5% stock establishes neither difference nor equivalence. Percentage basis, carrier and titrant/preparation remain unreported; a common-stock relationship requires affirmative source evidence.
